sentences.text: Amina Hussain is the health visitor conducting Leo and Poppy's two-year review.
Jade Turner is the mother of Leo and Poppy.
Leo is two years old and Poppy is five months old.
Leo can say about twenty words, including 'mama', 'car', 'more', 'bye-bye', and 'dog'.
Leo is able to put two words together, such as 'more juice'.
Leo is active and runs and climbs, having climbed the bookcase last week.
Leo's eating habits are fussy, with preferences for toast, pasta, and yoghurt.
Poppy is fed with bottles, approximately six per day, and has started on baby rice.
Poppy has a nappy rash that is severe, with broken skin, and has lasted about a week.
Jade has been applying Sudocrem to Poppy's nappy rash.
Jade has run out of nappies on Sunday and has been leaving them on longer.
Jade has only one tin of Poppy's milk left, which will last until Friday.
The milk supply will last until Friday, when Jade's Universal Credit payment comes in.
Jade has a cleaning job at a retail park, working nights from ten to twelve, sometimes half past twelve.
Jade's cleaning job is cash in hand.
Jade's friend Shannon looks after Leo and Poppy while she is at work, but Shannon cannot always do so.
When Shannon cannot look after the children, Jade leaves them alone for a couple of hours, while they are asleep and do not wake up.
Jade leaves the children alone for about three nights a week, since Shannon started her new job, over the last month.
Jade has not applied for nursery for Leo, who is two years old and eligible for 15 hours of funded nursery.
Little Acorns nursery on Marlow Road has spaces available from January and is recommended for Leo.
Jade is concerned that if she loses her cleaning job, she and her children will be evicted.
Jade has not received any letters from the landlord or notices of eviction.
Jade is worried that if something happens to Leo or Poppy—such as a fire or Poppy choking—there would be no one to help them, and this is a concern for the health visitor.
Jade's mother is in Northby and would help if she were to contact her, but they are not currently in contact.
Jade will not leave Leo and Poppy alone if Shannon cannot have them, and will text her supervisor to state she has no childcare.
Amina will make a referral to children's social care to support childcare arrangements.
Amina will drop a food bank voucher at the household before 3pm today.
Amina will book Poppy in with Dr Lowe for a nappy rash assessment tomorrow.
Amina will bring nappies to the household when she returns to see Poppy.
Amina will return to the household on Monday the 30th at 10am to support with the nursery form and check on the family's well-being.
